title: Observation
description: One recorded run of a task: its inputs, outputs, outcome, baseline, dirty state, and context.

task.description: Repo-relative task identifier (adapter-defined, stable across runs).

baseline.description: Opaque string naming the state the observation is valid for (usually a git commit SHA).

dirty.description: True if the observation was taken from a worktree with uncommitted changes.

context.description: Environment of the observation: tool versions, lockfile hash, env snapshot, capabilities.

inputs.description: Inputs the task read during the run. Each input has a kind-specific shape.

outputs.description: Files the task produced (recorded for explanation, not used for invalidation in v1).

outcome.description: Run result: pass, fail, error, or none (planned but not run).

duration_ms.description: Duration of the run in milliseconds.
